Name: Pelipper Town - SVE Garden Huts and Ranches
Author: neitolan
Description:
Lets Pokémon Huts and PokéRanch Markers work in Stardew Valley Expanded's Garden, the old community garden east of Pelican Town, which is offered to the player as their own farmable land. 
[list]
[*]Place and use Pokémon Huts in the Garden (farming) [/*]
[*]Place and use PokéRanch Markers in the Garden (passive levelling, item drops, and looking cute) [/*]
[*]The whole fenced Garden counts as a ranch enclosure, even with the open front, without needing additional fences or gates [/*]
[/list][b]Credits[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50344]Pelipper Town[/url] is an amazing Pokémon mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AlexanderVerde?gameId=1303]AlexanderVerde[/url], allowing the combination of two of my favourite all-time games. I adore having my favourite buddies with me as I explore. All credit for the original mod and Pokémon goes to them.
